title: Case: Freight planner messages the desk the afternoon before a two-pallet shelving delivery
context: Two pallets of flat-pack shelving from Tallowmere Goods are booked for a tail-lift delivery to a print works. The freight planner owns the booking and the load plan and deals with the receiving site directly.
initial_request: FYI only. DL-1730 has moved from trailer T-31 to T-44 for tomorrow's run after a load-balancing change at the hub. Both pallets scanned onto T-44 at 15:12. Same tail-lift vehicle type, same booked window 08:00–12:00, FB-2311 unchanged. I have told Rosalind at Kessock directly and she has acknowledged. No action required from the desk, this is for your records.

events.body: Route plan for depot CT-8 published for Tuesday. 36 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
My parcel DL-15352 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

DL-1730, 2 pallets flat-pack shelving, Tallowmere Goods to Kessock Print Works. Booked tail-lift delivery 2027-05-06, 08:00–12:00 UTC, booking FB-2311. Receiving contact Rosalind Oakshott has confirmed the window and that a pallet truck is on site.
Route plan for depot WX-2 published for Monday. 33 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Thursday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

Thanks,
Juno
--

must: Takes no action and sends no message to anyone.
Records the planner's update as information only: trailer changed from T-31 to T-44, booking FB-2311 and the 08:00–12:00 window on 2027-05-06 unchanged.
Notes that the freight planner owns the booking, has already told the receiving coordinator, and has said no action is required from the desk.
Notes that the desk next needs to look only if the planner or the receiving site reports a change to the window or a problem on the day.
must_not: Messages Rosalind Oakshott to pass on the trailer change she has already had from the freight planner.
Replies to the freight planner asking them to confirm the window or the booking again.
Tells the receiving site the pallets will arrive at a particular time, or that the delivery is confirmed as arriving, on the strength of a load scan.
Treats the trailer change as a delay or an exception and raises it with Dispatch or a supervisor.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments

rationale: Rule-made from gen-1103: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
